scripts.text:
[Amachang]
Welcome to Amatsu,
the town of kind towners
and beautiful cherry blossoms.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛畅]
欢迎来到樱花城，这里有亲切的居民，还有美丽的樱花。

scripts.text:
[Amachang]
I'm Amachang,
the 13th Miss Amatsu.
I will guide you about town
as Miss Amatsu.
Please tell me
if you want to know something.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛畅]
我是阿玛畅，第13届樱花城小姐。
身为樱花城小姐，我会为您介绍这座城镇。
有什么想了解的，尽管告诉我。

scripts.text: Palace
scripts.translation: 宫殿

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 道具店

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Bar
scripts.translation: 酒吧

scripts.text:
[Amachang]
On the mini-map,
go to ^FF3355+^000000
to find the Palace.
Have a good time
in Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[阿玛畅]
沿着小地图上^FF3355+^000000标记的方向走，就能找到宫殿。
祝您在樱花城玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Guide Man]
Welcome, tourist from Midgard.
I'm the guide of
our beautiful town, Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
欢迎您，来自米德加尔特的游客。
我是这座美丽城镇——樱花城的向导。

scripts.text:
[Guide Man]
What are you looking for?
scripts.translation:
[向导]
您在找什么？
